greeting: Hi, I'm the FandomVerse guide. Ask me about categories, characters, events, or merchandise, or tap a quick question below.
fallback: I don't have an answer for that yet — I'm a simple rule-based guide, not a live AI. Try asking about a category, characters, events, or merchandise.
disclaimer: I answer from a fixed set of topics only — I'm not a live AI service.
quickPrompts: Where can I find character profiles?

intents.response: FandomVerse covers seven categories: Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga. Open any category page from the navigation to browse its articles, characters, events, and trailers.
Character profiles live on the Characters page, and you can filter by category. Each profile has a bio, series, and key traits.

The Merchandise page lets you browse items and add them to a cart with a running total — but checkout and real purchases aren't part of this demo. Everything shown is original, fictional fan merchandise.
The Events page lists upcoming fandom events across all seven categories — filter by category to find what's relevant to you.
Trailers, interviews, and podcast-style clips are on the Trailers page, filterable by category and content type.
Featured Articles are on the home page and the Articles page — open any card to read the full piece.
Use the search icon in the navigation bar to search across articles, characters, events, and merchandise from any page.
Every series, character, and item on FandomVerse is original and fictional, created for this project — nothing here is a real licensed franchise.
Tap the bookmark icon on any article or character card to save it — bookmarks are stored in your browser only, using local storage.
